class.name: AssetVault
class.brief_description: A singleton that holds the granted per-asset decryption keys for vault-encrypted assets.
class.description: The Asset Vault encrypts exported assets per asset (AES-128-GCM) so that their contents, file types and original paths are hidden in the exported game. Assets are loaded at runtime exclusively through their [code]uid://[/code] paths; a vault-encrypted asset can only be loaded after the key-granting server has granted its per-asset key to this singleton. The client never receives the master key. Keys are derived deterministically from the master key, so the same key can be derived independently by the server and the export machine: [codeblock] key = HKDF-SHA256( IKM = master, # 32+ bytes, hex-encoded for humans salt = "godot-asset-vault-v1", info = "uid://<uid-text>:<tag>", # tag = key rotation counter L = 16) # AES-128 [/codeblock] [b]Warning:[/b] [method AssetVault.derive_key] and [method AssetVault.masterkey_from_env] are intended for export machines and key-granting servers. Never ship a client build with the master key present in its environment or export presets — that defeats the vault entirely. To load a vault-encrypted asset, grant its key first: [codeblock] AssetVault.grant_key("uid://b3l4r8xqnld0n", key) # key received from the server var texture = load("uid://b3l4r8xqnld0n") [/codeblock] Without a granted key the load fails with an [code]@GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED[/code] error naming the missing uid. With a wrong or stale key (for example, granted before the asset's key was rotated), the load fails with a corruption error that includes the container's key tag. Once a resource is loaded it stays in the resource cache; revoking the key does not evict already-loaded resources, it only affects future loads.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets all granted keys (best-effort zeroization of key buffers). Affects future loads only; already-loaded resources stay in the resource cache.

method.name: grant_key
method.description: Grants the per-asset AES-128 key (exactly 16 bytes) for the given uid (in [code]uid://[/code] text form or as a numeric uid string). Idempotent. After a key is granted, the asset can be loaded through its [code]uid://[/code] path until the key is revoked or [method clear] is called.

method.name: has_key
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a key is currently granted for the given uid.

method.name: revoke_key
method.description: Forgets the granted key for the given uid. Future loads of the asset fail with [code]@GlobalScope.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED[/code] until a new key is granted. Affects future loads only.

method.name: derive_key
method.description: Derives the per-asset AES-128 key (16 bytes) for the given uid and key rotation tag via HKDF-SHA256. Intended for the export machine and the key-granting server: given the same master key, uid and tag, the same key is derived everywhere. [b]Warning:[/b] keep the master key off client machines.

method.name: masterkey_from_env
method.description: Reads and hex-decodes the [code]GODOT_VAULT_MASTERKEY[/code] environment variable. Returns an empty array if it is unset or invalid. Intended for the export machine and the key-granting server.

method.name: get_vault_path
method.description: Returns the uniform in-pack path a vault-encrypted asset is exported to: [code]res://.vault/<uid-text>.enc[/code].

method.name: hex_to_bytes
method.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string (optional [code]0x[/code] prefix, even length) into bytes. Returns an empty array for invalid input.
